key_insight: SVD-THC enables a single multiplexed block encoding for molecular Hamiltonian ensembles, with Toffoli cost growing only weakly as more geometries are included.
engineering_relevance: The method could reduce fault-tolerant quantum computing costs for coherently exploring molecular conformations and reactivity.
method: Extend tensor hypercontraction across molecular geometries using singular value decomposition.
Construct one multiplexed block encoding for the ensemble.
Use the encoding in an energy-thresholding circuit.
evidence_signal: Tests on 1-bromo-2-chloroethane, glycine dipeptide, and alanine dipeptide ensembles of up to 5,184 geometries showed at most 12% Toffoli-cost variation across grids differing by up to 576× in size, and 35–200× fewer Toffoli gates for energy thresholding than stitching together single-geometry encodings.
watch_item: The reported savings concern circuit resource estimates on selected molecular ensembles; generalization to broader chemical systems and practical fault-tolerant implementation remain to be established.
paper_title: Efficient Block Encodings for Ensembles of Molecular Hamiltonians
